description: Work-native selective orchestration led by GPT-5.6 Sol, with risk-gated Luna/Terra delegation and fresh Sol review.

interface.shortDescription: Sol-led Work orchestration with selective Luna/Terra delegation and fresh Sol review.
interface.longDescription: A ChatGPT Work-native adaptation of Sol Advisor. Keep GPT-5.6 Sol in the parent session for intent, architecture, routing, verification, and acceptance. Use hosted Work subagents explicitly: GPT-5.6 Luna for mechanical/light bounded work, GPT-5.6 Terra for medium or judgment-heavy execution, and a fresh GPT-5.6 Sol for independent review when risk justifies it. Parallelize read-heavy work; serialize shared-state writes. Never claim per-agent sandbox isolation in Work.
defaultPrompt: Orchestrate this task with Sol Advisor Work. Keep Sol as the control plane and delegate only when delegation improves quality, speed, or context hygiene.
Use parallel subagents for independent read-heavy work, a single writer for shared-state changes, and a fresh Sol review only when risk warrants it.
